# Exit-code contract: 0 = success, 1 = the command ran but its result is a
# failure the caller can act on (failed page validation, drift detected),
# 2 = the command could not run (usage mistake or internal fault). Result
# signals must not add error noise, and usage/internal faults must be labelled
# on stderr.
#
# The script comes first and input files are declared last: testscript treats
# the txtar comment (text before the first "-- file --" marker) as the script.

# === SUCCESS: write and raw status exit 0 ===

exec akb init exit-kb
cd exit-kb

stdin ../ok-note.md
exec akb write notes/ok.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/ok.md'

stdin ../raw-data.csv
exec akb raw write data.csv
exec akb raw status
stdout 'no drift'

# === VALIDATION FAILURE: exit 1, every failed rule on stderr, no page written ===

exec bash -c 'akb write decisions/missing-sections.md <../missing-sections-adr.md; echo "akb-exit=$?"'
stdout 'akb-exit=1$'
stderr 'require_context'
stderr 'require_decision'
stderr 'require_consequences'
stderr 'disallow_options'
stderr -count=4 '^\['
! exists kb/decisions/missing-sections.md

# === UNKNOWN TYPE: content failure the caller can fix, exit 1 ===

exec bash -c 'akb write notes/unknown.md <../unknown-type.md; echo "akb-exit=$?"'
stdout 'akb-exit=1$'
stderr 'unknown type'

# === DRIFT RESULT: drift report, exit 1, no error noise ===

cp ../raw-modified.csv raw/data.csv

exec bash -c 'akb raw status; echo "akb-exit=$?"'
stdout 'MODIFIED data.csv'
stdout 'akb-exit=1$'
! stderr 'Error'
! stderr 'usage:'
! stderr 'internal:'

exec bash -c 'akb raw status --json; echo "akb-exit=$?"'
stdout '"modified": 1'
stdout 'akb-exit=1$'
! stderr 'Error'
! stderr 'usage:'
! stderr 'internal:'

# === INTERNAL FAULT: exit 2 with internal: prefix ===

cp ../broken-template.yaml .akb/templates/broken.yaml

exec bash -c 'akb write broken/page.md <../broken-page.md; echo "akb-exit=$?"'
stdout 'akb-exit=2$'
stderr 'internal: CEL engine error: compile rule broken_rule'
! exists kb/broken/page.md

cp ../corrupt-manifest.txt raw/files.log

exec bash -c 'akb raw status; echo "akb-exit=$?"'
stdout 'akb-exit=2$'
stderr 'internal:'
stderr 'files.log is corrupted'

# === USAGE ERROR: exit 2 with usage: prefix ===

rm -rf raw

exec bash -c 'akb raw status; echo "akb-exit=$?"'
stdout 'akb-exit=2$'
stderr 'usage: raw/ directory not found'

-- ok-note.md --
---
type: note
title: Ok note
created: "2020-01-01T00:00:00Z"
---

# Ok note

A note that passes every validation rule.

-- missing-sections-adr.md --
---
type: adr
title: Missing sections
summary: ADR without the required sections
tags: [test]
status: proposed
deciders: team
created: "2020-01-01T00:00:00Z"
updated: "2020-01-01T00:00:00Z"
---

# Missing sections

## Options

An ADR that violates four validation rules at once.

-- unknown-type.md --
---
type: nonexistent
title: Unknown type
---

A page whose type has no template.

-- raw-data.csv --
hello

-- raw-modified.csv --
modified

-- broken-template.yaml --
name: broken
description: Template with an invalid CEL rule
dir: broken
schema:
  frontmatter:
    title:
      type: string
      required: true
    type:
      type: string
      required: true
validations:
  - id: broken_rule
    rule: 'this is not valid CEL (('
    requirement: never satisfiable
    expect: never reported

-- broken-page.md --
---
type: broken
title: Page for a template whose rule does not compile
---

Content that never reaches validation.

-- corrupt-manifest.txt --
invalid line without pipes
